description: Trigger evaluation dataset for resilience-patterns skill. 6 queries: 3 should trigger, 3 should NOT trigger.

queries.query: Configura Polly v8 con retry policies y circuit breaker para los HttpClients del proyecto
queries.note: Caso principal: Polly retry + circuit breaker

queries.query: Add health check endpoints (/health, /ready, /live) and graceful shutdown to the API
queries.note: English trigger: health checks + graceful shutdown

queries.query: Implementa bulkhead isolation y timeout policies para tolerancia a fallos
queries.note: Keywords: bulkhead + timeout + tolerancia a fallos

queries.query: Configura Serilog y OpenTelemetry para logging y métricas distribuidas
queries.note: NEGATIVE: Debe activar observability-patterns. Logging/métricas != resiliencia

queries.query: Conecta con la API externa del catalogo usando HttpClientFactory y OAuth2
queries.note: NEGATIVE: Debe activar api-integration-patterns. Integrar API != configurar resiliencia

queries.query: Review the security of the retry mechanism for potential DoS amplification
queries.note: NEGATIVE: Debe activar security-audit. Auditar seguridad del retry != configurar retry

overlap_notes.observability-patterns: Health checks: resilience = recovery/fault tolerance, observability = monitoring/metrics
overlap_notes.api-integration-patterns: Polly: resilience configura PATRONES genéricos, api-integration incluye Polly como parte de integración API completa
